visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a wide-angle CCTV view of a storefront's outdoor entryway at night. Two individuals wearing black hooded jackets, dark pants, and face masks are standing near a white display panel on a pillar. One person is seen using their hands and a possible tool to hit or pry at the panel repeatedly while the other stands closely beside them. (2) The individuals continue their persistent physical actions against the white wall and panel, appearing to exert force to damage or remove the fixture. The lighting is dim and artificial, provided by overhead lamps that cast harsh shadows on the tiled pavement. The background consists of a darkened street and building pillars. (3) After several seconds of consistent hitting and prying, the two individuals abruptly stop their activity and walk away from the camera's view toward the right side of the frame. Red and white text boxes with captions are overlaid at the top and bottom of the screen throughout the take.
